label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler’s 21st PGA Tour Win
items.text: Scottie Scheffler earned his 21st PGA Tour victory Sunday at the FedEx St. Jude Championship, placing him behind only Tiger Woods and Jack Nicklaus on the all-time leads list.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Tough FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Rory McIlroy finished 66th at the FedEx St. Jude Championship, 25 shots behind Scottie Scheffler, after a difficult start left him ‘feeling lost.’
